> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4a87d0908ccba61193270b495efb7c557cc59f56` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `294dc81526da410e05bd4e9ecfea4f4804b726ea` — the merge of head `043b81d1330fe4c66f4f1c0526bf999a2e1247eb` into base `4a87d0908ccba61193270b495efb7c557cc59f56`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 294dc81526da410e05bd4e9ecfea4f4804b726ea && git checkout 294dc81526da410e05bd4e9ecfea4f4804b726ea
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4a87d0908ccba61193270b495efb7c557cc59f56 043b81d1330fe4c66f4f1c0526bf999a2e1247eb && git checkout -B drift-repro 4a87d0908ccba61193270b495efb7c557cc59f56 && git merge --no-ff 043b81d1330fe4c66f4f1c0526bf999a2e1247eb

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4a87d0908ccba61193270b495efb7c557cc59f56
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4a87d0908ccba61193270b495efb7c557cc59f56` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `043b81d1330fe4c66f4f1c0526bf999a2e1247eb`
Local-runs: none

PR #23110, Half 1 of #23104 (the console pin hop `7578323a544e` → `1fb1ced36243`), rendered 2026-10-13T01:00Z from the card body and its three comments (claim 6133691607, os-dev-report 6134727906, seat ACCEPT 6134777078), the PR body, its 21-file list, the net diff against `main`, and the 41 check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`.objectui-sha` `7578323a544e31d574804ae931b595e8f9f92c21` → `1fb1ced36243c325acc801bdde26bd096a15f5f5`** — the exact sha the card named at filing, stated in full in the PR body as objectui `main`'s tip re-read by `git ls-remote` when the work started. Right. The card's acceptance clause "the PR states the exact objectui sha it pins" is met.
2. **`packages/spec/src/**` (14 files, +178/−49) publishes no accept-set change.** Every changed line sits inside a `/* … */` or `//` comment, or inside a string literal: the six migration entries' `description` strings (pin sha, corpus 8600 → 8642, the lit controls appended) and the `FormField.span` `.describe()` in `view.zod.ts` (the pin sha only; the sentence is otherwise byte-identical). No key, default, enum member, refinement, tombstone or export moves. `functional-completeness.ts` +21/−3 is docblock only. Right.
3. **`content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`** — two generated table rows re-rendered from that describe, the same text with the pin moved. Right (`Build Docs`, `Check Documentation Links` success on this head).
4. **`sdui.manifest.json`** — one value: the `record:activity` input `showCompleted`'s description gains one sentence (objectui#12228). 107 components, no component, input, type or default added or removed, so the served catalog is unchanged in shape and no public surface expands. `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` re-recorded at the pin (`objectuiSha`, `modulesRoot`, sha256 `f545b851c4bb…`). `check-sdui-manifest` (with `--self-test`) ran inside `Lint · repo & tooling gates`: success. Right.
5. **`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`** — `rev`, `revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` move; the file list and grammar region do not, which is the shape of a hop across which objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` is byte-identical. `check:sdui-lockstep` in the same job: success. No parser port owed. Right.
6. **Console changeset `.changeset/console-1fb1ced36243.md`** — 10 releasing entries of 11 changesets over 11 non-merge commits, 2 commits with no changeset listed by subject; the commit set matches the card's own reading of the hop (objectui#12242, #12228, #12238, #12243, #12248, #12254, #12244, #12249, #12268, CI #12222 and #12208/#12256). Two entries marked **BREAKING** by their authors' annotation, the count line reading 2, the objectui#12242 `@object-ui/types` entry hand-marked after the digest's block-opener rule missed a heading opening with a warning sign (the PR body and the changeset's adr-0087 marker block both say so). Right: the mark follows the upstream annotation, and the hand edit is declared where the gate reads it.
7. **ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`** — right for this diff, on the repo's own refusals: `QUARANTINED_WIDGET_KEYS` is `['component', 'data']` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:188`), so the legacy widget envelope objectui#12254 narrows is already refused to every ObjectStack author; the nine members objectui#12242 turns into `never` (`visible_on`, `currency`-as-metadata, `filterable`, `min_date`, `max_date`, `default_zoom`, `starting_number`, `schema`, `normalize`) occur nowhere in `packages/spec/src` and `FieldSchema` is a strict object, so none is writable here; the spec's field-type vocabulary spells `autonumber`, never `auto_number`. Nothing authorable in this repo moves, so no FROM → TO prescription is owed in this changeset. `Check Changeset` (runs `check-adr-0087-registration --base MERGE_BASE`) success; `check:objectui-changeset` and `check:objectui-bump` inside `Lint · docs & code guards` success.
8. **No `(narrowing)` arm owed** — neither declared-breaking upstream entry narrows an accept set a released package of this repo publishes (item 7); the console's accept set is `@objectstack/spec`'s, which this diff leaves untouched (item 2). Right.
9. **Pin citations re-measured for this hop only** — every asserting record gains a hop sentence; the `calendar` row of `functional-completeness.ts` records the one cited file set that changed (the `en`/`zh`/`de` packs, objectui#12248 and #12268, keys added below line 1100) with `calendar.configRequired` held at `:953` / `:726` / `:706`; every other record cites byte-identical files. `check:objectui-pin-citations` ran inside `Type Check · source gates`: success (the `--verify-anchors` pass is the dev's local reading, 13 anchors). Right as far as the diff and the gate show.
10. **Changeset `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-1fb1ced36243.md`** — `@objectstack/spec` patch, states "No key, default, enum member or export moves", which item 2 confirms against the diff. Right.

### ② Semver level

- **`@objectstack/console`: minor** — right. The highest entry level in the range is minor; objectui prices its declared-breaking entries minor inside a launch window (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`), and AGENTS.md's declaration rule admits `no` beside `minor` (only `yes` forces a floor, only `(narrowing)` names a break). Precedent #23061 is the same shape.
- **`@objectstack/spec`: patch** — right. A `.describe()` string and six `description` strings change what ships in the schema's JSON-schema and reference text, and nothing else; a published change takes `patch`, never none.
- **No `skip-changeset`** — right; both packages publish.
- **The PR body's `Clause-②: no` line** (line 2, line-initial; repeated in both changesets and the claim) — right. No accept set widens and no public surface of a released package of this repo expands: the spec diff is prose and string text (①.2), the manifest keeps 107 components and every input (①.4), the console dist is the same catalog at a newer pin. No arm is owed (①.8).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: `[]`** — none declared; nothing to answer.
- **Out-of-scope finding (digest misses a BREAKING heading that opens with a warning sign; `hasBreakingAnnotation` / `BREAKING_BLOCK_OPENER` in `scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs`)** — correctly kept out of this PR (the digest is not in the card's file surface) and declared in the PR body's Acceptance notes. The seat's ACCEPT comment (6134777078) records it filed as #23112; this record does not re-verify that card, which sits outside its inputs. Escalated as answered-by-filing.
- **Deviation 1, base moved (worktree off `55828c514`, `origin/main` `36b2889cd` merged before the final gate run)** — the check-runs on this head are the verdict against the merge base GitHub computed (PR base now `4a87d0908`); all 36 that ran are success. Answered.
- **Deviation 2, console changeset hand-edited (second BREAKING mark, count 2)** — matches the upstream annotation (①.6, ①.7); the gates that read the changeset are green on this head. Answered.
- **Deviations 3–5 and 8 (two `build-console.sh` runs, an additive `git fetch --depth=1` of `621a48760788` for one self-test fixture, smoke prerequisites built, worktree cleanup)** — local-only acts with no trace in the diff; the tracked manifest and record agree per `check-sdui-manifest`. Answered.
- **Deviation 6, attribution trailer form** — AGENTS.md's own form; not a contract matter. Answered.
- **Deviation 7, where Half 2 runs** — resolved by the seat's ACCEPT comment: a separate detached tree at objectstack `36b2889c` with `.objectui-sha` set to `1fb1ced36243` and a manifest byte-identical to this PR's. Answered.
- **Check-runs on this head: 41, of which 36 success, 5 skipped, 0 failure.** The skips are not this PR's: `Console Pin Gate`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` and the `Dogfood Regression Gate` shards carry the full battery only since #22998 (their `if:` in ci.yml denies `pull_request` and `merge_group`; the `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregate counts zero attestations and concludes success by design), and `Packed-tarball smoke` is opt-in. **Consequence, escalated to the seat:** `check:console-sha` and `check:console-injection --require-stamp` run only inside `Console Pin Gate`, so they have no CI verdict on this head although the card's acceptance line names `check:console-sha`. The only reading is the dev's local Console Pin Gate run at `043b81d13` (client build, `build-console.sh`, `check:console-sha`, `check:console-injection --require-stamp`, each exit 0, reported in comment 6134727906). The CI reading arrives with the first full-battery run on `main` after landing; a red there is a main-red for the console lane and a regression of this hop. The seat should read that run and the card should treat it, not the PR path, as the `check:console-sha` acceptance.
- **Landing hold** — this verdict judges the diff. The card holds landing until both Half 2 `qa-run` records report no regression inside the hop's objectui commits, and the PR is still a draft; nothing in this record releases either. `Part-of PR must not also close its card` success: merging cannot close #23104, as the card requires.
